verdict: MercadoLibre grew revenue 50% to $10.2B — its fastest pace in four years — as shoppers bought more often and Mercado Pago handled $101B of payments, while deliberate spending on free shipping and credit held operating profit to $683M.

kpis.label: Revenue growth
kpis.note: Net revenues & financial income of $10.2B vs $6.8B in Q2 2025, in dollars; up 43% ignoring currency moves

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP diluted)
kpis.note: Diluted earnings per share, vs $10.31 a year ago; net income was $466M

kpis.label: Gross merchandise volume
kpis.note: The total value of goods sold on the marketplace (GMV), up 44% in dollars

kpis.label: Total payment volume
kpis.note: The total value of payments processed by Mercado Pago (TPV), up 56% in dollars

segments.name: Commerce
segments.note: Marketplace fees, shipping, first-party product sales, advertising and MELI+ subscriptions. Brazil alone brought in $5.5B of total company revenue.

segments.name: Fintech
segments.note: Mercado Pago payment fees, financing fees and interest earned on consumer and merchant credit, plus point-of-sale devices. The credit portfolio reached $16.4B, up 75% YoY.

opex.name: Product and technology development
opex.note: Building and running the marketplace, payments platform and AI tools.

opex.name: Sales and marketing
opex.note: Advertising and customer acquisition across Latin America.

opex.name: Provision for doubtful accounts
opex.note: Money set aside for loans and credit-card balances that may not be repaid, as the credit book grows.

takeaways.title: Fastest growth in four years
takeaways.text: Revenue passed $10B in a quarter for the first time. Shoppers bought more often — items per buyer rose 14% — a year after the free-shipping threshold was cut in Brazil.

takeaways.title: Margin is a choice, for now
takeaways.text: Operating margin fell to 6.7% from 12.1% a year ago as MercadoLibre spends on shipping, warehouses and credit-card issuance. Management calls it deliberate: users who use both marketplace and Pago spend far more.

takeaways.title: The credit book is ballooning
takeaways.text: The loan and credit-card portfolio grew 75% YoY to $16.4B, with 2.6 million new cards issued in the quarter. The bad-debt provision — $1.28B this quarter — grows with it.

otherDetail: Below operating income, $30M of interest income and other financial gains was more than offset by $62M of interest expense and other financial losses and $45M of foreign-currency losses, for a net other expense of $77M.
footerNote: MercadoLibre reports 'net revenues and financial income' — marketplace sales plus Mercado Pago's financial income; its cost line includes financial expenses.
